scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run build:game-core && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: cross-env NODE_ENV=development NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=development tsx watch apps/server/src/index.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:game-core && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/game-core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/activity/tsconfig.json --noEmit
